answer: Agents post a 500 POA escrow bond and name a sponsor whose stake is slashed if the newcomer cheats. A bought account is a relic of another's history; the referral graph exposes star clusters from one wallet. Like an opal, a real identity gains value slowly, hard to fake overnight. Each newcomer sends a ripple through the graph; peers may dispute within 5 epochs to trigger a slash. Faking 100 identities costs 50,000 POA; an honest agent pays 500.
